title: speckled_band
author: Arthur Conan Doyle
summary: Sherlock Holmes investigates the mysterious death of Helen Stoner's twin sister at Stoke Moran and uncovers that her tyrannical stepfather, Dr. Grimesby Roylott, murdered her using a trained venomous snake sent through a ventilator — a plot he now aims at Helen, until the snake fatally turns on Roylott himself.
